title: hermes configuration
description: Schema for /etc/hermes.yaml — the hermes OCI image approval system configuration file.

addr.description: TCP address the gateway server listens on (e.g. ':8080', '0.0.0.0:8080').

url.description: Public base URL of the hermes gateway, used to rewrite WWW-Authenticate realm headers through /ident/. Defaults to http://<hostname>:<port> when not set.

redirect.description: When true, hermes sends HTTP 307 redirects for non-manifest upstream paths (blobs, tag lists, etc.) instead of reverse-proxying them. Approved manifest requests are always proxied.

ui.description: Operator web console settings (used by 'hermes ui').

addr.description: TCP address the operator UI listens on (e.g. ':8090', '0.0.0.0:8090').

url.description: Public base URL of the operator UI. Defaults to http://<hostname>:<port> when not set. The UI itself does not enforce auth; deploy behind a reverse proxy that does.

base_path.description: Mount prefix used in rendered URLs (assets, links, htmx hx-get/hx-post, SSE connect). Inferred from ui.url's path when unset. Set explicitly when serving the UI at a non-root path through a reverse proxy that strips the prefix before forwarding.

host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address.

trivy.description: Settings for the trivy vulnerability scanner (run as a Docker container).

image.description: Docker image to use for trivy.

args.description: Extra CLI arguments appended to 'trivy image' before the image reference.

convert_args.description: Extra CLI arguments appended to 'trivy convert' before the input path.

format.description: Logger wire format. 'json' emits standard slog JSON (Loki-compatible). 'journald' emits JSON using journald field conventions (MESSAGE, PRIORITY as syslog 0-7).

cache_url.description: Default registry URL for 'hermes approve --cache'. Used when --cache is given without a URL.
